title: Articles
searchPlaceholder: Search: name, SKU, alternative SKU, GTIN

empty.filtered: No articles match the search and filter.

season.endBeforeStart: The season end must not be before the start.

altSku.tooLong: A SKU may be at most {{max}} characters long.
altSku.self: An article cannot be its own substitute.
altSku.totalTooLong: All alternative SKUs together may be at most {{max}} characters long.
altSku.loading: The article list is still loading — please try again in a moment.
altSku.notFound: No article with the SKU {{sku}} found.
altSku.unknownTitle: There is no (longer an) article with this SKU

bundle.duplicate: Is already a component of this bundle.
bundle.quantityRange: The quantity of each component must be a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
bundle.none: Not a bundle. As soon as components are added, the article is a bundle: it has no stock of its own, and an order for it is resolved into its components when picking.

gtin.digitsOnly: A GTIN may only contain digits.
gtin.length: A GTIN must have 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits (given: {{count}}).
gtin.zeros: A GTIN must not consist only of zeros.
gtin.checkDigit: The GTIN check digit is wrong (expected {{expected}}).

leave.title: Discard changes?
leave.body: This article has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you leave the page.

editor.gtinTaken: This GTIN is already assigned to another article.
editor.identifiersHint: The GTIN/EAN is the barcode on the packaging; scanning it finds the article in the warehouse. It is unique and its check digit is verified. Leave empty = no GTIN. Alternative SKUs are further codes under which this article can be found: article search takes them into account, and when scanning they apply if no article uses the code as SKU or GTIN. They do not suggest a substitute article when stock is missing.
editor.thresholdsHint: MinStock = absolute low (alarm). ReorderPoint = trigger for reordering. MaxStock = "do not restock further". 0 = not set.
editor.seasonHint: The article can only be ordered within the window (flag above). The last day still counts in full. Empty = all year.
